sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Read for errors.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Hide under a false appearance. (2) Behave unnaturally or affectedly.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تلقین کردن، تکرار و پند و اندرز دادن، پُر کردن، سرشار کردن

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An inclination to do something. (2) A natural inclination. (3) A disposition to behave in a certain way.

persianMeaning: تاریک‌رو، بدخلق، خودکاری، ابری، تیره، ابرپوشیده

englishDefinition: Generate and separate from cells or bodily fluids. (2) Place out of sight; keep secret.

englishDefinition: Separate or cut with a tool, such as a sharp instrument. (2) Make by cutting into.

persianMeaning: پیچیده‌تر کردن، دشوار کردن، پیچیده‌تر، پیش‌رفته‌تر یا غنی‌تر کردن، پیچیده، دشوار درک
englishDefinition: Difficult to analyze or understand.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Make pliant and flexible.

englishDefinition: An additional charge (as for items previously omitted or as a penalty for failure to exercise common caution or common skill). (2) Charge an extra fee, as for a special service. (3) Fill to capacity with people.
